title: Claude conventions
description: Per-repository values read by the conventions plugin (hooks, skills and agents) from .claude/conventions.json. Only integrationBranch is required; every other key overrides a detected or default value. Unknown keys are allowed: the hooks ignore them.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor validation.

integrationBranch.description: Branch every pull request targets. Required: hooks that need it warn and skip their check when it is absent.

productionBranch.description: Deployed branch, only reachable through the release PR (gh pr create --base <productionBranch> --head <last promotionBranches entry, else integrationBranch>). Default: the branch origin/HEAD points to, else main. Must differ from integrationBranch.

promotionBranches.description: Ordered branches between integrationBranch and productionBranch, promoted one hop at a time by merge-commit PRs (e.g. ["demo"] for staging → demo → main). Each one is protected like the integration and production branches; only the last one may open the PR into productionBranch, and every hop (--base <next> --head <previous>) is exempt from the PR size cap. Default: empty (the release pair integrationBranch → productionBranch).

packageManager.description: Package manager whose add/install commands must pin exact versions. Default: detected from the lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, bun.lock/bun.lockb); two lockfiles leave it unset and the dependency guard warns instead of blocking.

formatter.description: Formatter run on every edited .ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.cjs/.json/.css file. Default: biome when biome.json or biome.jsonc exists, prettier when a .prettierrc*, prettier.config.* or a prettier key in package.json exists, else none.

prSize.description: Size cap enforced on gh pr create.

exclude.description: Glob patterns not counted toward the cap. Replaces the whole default list: **/pnpm-lock.yaml, **/package-lock.json, **/yarn.lock, **/migrations/**, **/components/ui/**.

label.description: PR label that bypasses the cap when passed as --label. Default: large-pr.

apps.description: Application name to directory (relative to the repository root) for multi-app repositories. Absent or empty: single-app repository.

adrDir.description: Directory of the Architecture Decision Records. Default: docs/adr.

deployNote.description: Free-text note about how the production branch is deployed; written by the port skill and rendered into the rule templates. Not read by the hooks.
